description: Build the trading panel container and layout
steps: Create TradingPanel component in web/src/components/event/trading-panel.tsx
Implement sticky positioning on desktop (top offset for header)
Add card styling with border, shadow, and padding
Create collapsed/expanded state for mobile
Add expand button for mobile collapsed view
Ensure panel doesn't overlap with footer on scroll

description: Build the outcome selection UI within trading panel
steps: Create OutcomeSelector component with radio-button style selection
Display all outcomes with prices (Yes 12c, No 88c)
Highlight selected outcome with accent color
Show real-time price for each outcome
Support keyboard navigation between outcomes
Emit selected outcome ID on change
Create TradeDirectionToggle component
Implement segmented control with Buy/Sell options
Color code: Buy=green, Sell=red
Update panel UI based on selected direction
Store direction in component state
Add keyboard shortcut hints (B for Buy, S for Sell)

description: Build the trade amount input with validation
steps: Create TradeAmountInput component with numeric input
Add USD prefix/suffix indicator
Implement quick-select buttons ($10, $50, $100, $500)
Add input validation (min $1, max based on liquidity)
Show shares calculation: amount / price = shares
Display potential payout: shares * $1 (for winning outcome)
Show ROI percentage: (payout - amount) / amount * 100

description: Build trade summary display before submission
steps: Create TradeSummary component showing order details
Display: Outcome, Direction, Amount, Shares, Avg Price
Show potential return with percentage
Add estimated fees line (placeholder)
Show total cost/proceeds
Update summary in real-time as inputs change

description: Implement the trade submission button with dummy action
steps: Create TradeSubmitButton component
Style as primary action button (full width, prominent)
Show 'Buy [Outcome]' or 'Sell [Outcome]' text
Add loading state during 'submission'
On click: show toast notification 'Trading coming soon!'
Add confetti animation or success feedback
Disable button if amount is invalid or no outcome selected

description: Handle unauthenticated users in trading panel
steps: Check authentication status in TradingPanel
Show 'Log in to trade' button for unauthenticated users
Redirect to login with return URL to event page
Show full trading panel for authenticated users
Display user's current position if they have one

description: Show user's current position in this market
steps: Create PositionDisplay component
Fetch user's position from wallet_position_state if authenticated
Show: Shares held, Avg cost, Current value, PnL
Color code PnL (green positive, red negative)
Add 'Close Position' button placeholder
Show position only if user has non-zero position
